title: 99 Agility The FASTEST way l Runescape Dragonwilds
author: Hoppin Hammer
description:
Crazy fast agility experience compared to running courses. In this video, I break down some tips to make the most of this training method.
Items discussed for best experience rates include:
1. Your best agility potion
2. Ring of agility
3. "Sea Life" buff food. (Eggs royale, undead delight, etc.)
4. Evasive infusion
5. Any magic staff
6. Water runes
7. At least one set piece of magic armor (for stamina regen)
